```{r,echo=FALSE}
blanks = c("What percent of 40 is 24?",
"24 is what percent of 40?",
"24 out of 40 is what percent?",
"what percent is 24 out of 40?",
"60% of 40 is what?",
"What is 60% of 40?",
"What out of 40 is 60%?",
"60% is what out of 40?",
"60% of what is 24?",
"24 is 60% of what?",
"24 out of what is 60%?",
"60% is 24 out of what?")

eqs = c("\\frac{x}{100}\\cdot 40 = 24",
        "24 = \\frac{x}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "\\frac{24}{40}=\\frac{x}{100}",
        "\\frac{x}{100}=\\frac{24}{40}",
        "\\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40 = x",
        "x = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "\\frac{x}{40} = \\frac{60}{100}",
        "\\frac{60}{100} = \\frac{x}{40}",
        "\\frac{60}{100}\\cdot x = 24",
        "24 = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot x",
        "\\frac{24}{x} = \\frac{60}{100}",
        "\\frac{60}{100} = \\frac{24}{x}")

eq2 = c("x = \\frac{24}{40}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{40}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{40}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{40}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "x = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "x = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "x = \\frac{60}{100}\\cdot 40",
        "x = \\frac{24}{60}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{60}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{60}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{24}{60}\\cdot 100")

while(T){
    part = sample(1:200,1)
    whole = sample(1:200,1)
    perc = part/whole*100
    if(perc%%1==0 && perc<100 && whole != 100){break}
}
ii = sample(1:length(blanks),1)
blank = blanks[ii]
qstr = gsub("24",part,blank,fixed=T)
qstr = gsub("60",perc,qstr,fixed=T)
qstr = gsub("40",whole,qstr,fixed=T)

eq = eqs[ii]
eq = gsub("24",part,eq,fixed=T)
eq = gsub("60",perc,eq,fixed=T)
eq = gsub("40",whole,eq,fixed=T)


eq2 = eq2[ii]
eq2 = gsub("24",part,eq2,fixed=T)
eq2 = gsub("60",perc,eq2,fixed=T)
eq2 = gsub("40",whole,eq2,fixed=T)

if(ii %in% 1:4){
    astr = paste0(perc,"%",collapse="")
    aa = gsub("what percent",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What percent",astr,aa,fixed=T)
}
if(ii %in% 5:8){
    astr = paste0(part)
    aa = gsub("what",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What",astr,aa,fixed=T)
}
if(ii %in% 9:12){
    astr = paste0(whole)
    aa = gsub("what",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What",astr,aa,fixed=T)
}

aa = gsub("?",".",aa,fixed=T)

```

Question
========

`r qstr`


Solution
========

Turn the sentence into an equation.

$$`r eq`$$

Find the value of $x$ that satisfies the equation.

$$`r eq2`$$

Use a calculator to find the answer is ``r astr``.


`r aa`
